response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems developer with strong distributed systems and infrastructure exposure (low-latency D services, Kubernetes deployments, DevOps/CI setup), but his career and current skillset center on TypeScript/Node.js and web/mobile platforms rather than C++. His only substantial C++ experience (~6 months at National Instruments plus a bachelor thesis project) falls far short of the required 8 years of C++ programming, and there's no clear evidence of formal technical leadership managing cloud/DevOps engineers or owning large-scale compute platform strategy.
strengths: Broad, deep experience across distributed systems, infrastructure, DevOps, and Kubernetes deployments
Demonstrated technical leadership through founding/running an open-source platform, workshops, and mentoring (Refactoring Dojos, Selenium courses)
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, architecture) with 15+ years of professional experience
concerns: C++ experience is minimal (~6 months professionally) versus the required 8 years
No explicit large-scale cloud compute platform leadership role managing teams or cross-team alignment
Current and recent roles are heavily web/product-focused (TypeScript/Node.js) rather than infrastructure/compute platform focused

key_factors.factor: Lack of formal cloud platform technical leadership role
Strong distributed systems/infrastructure and mentoring background
